title: Choose the visual world for brickbot.ro (round 6, familiar)
question: This is the sixth hand. If none of these is right, please use Steer to name what is still missing, or name a direction from an earlier round you'd like to go back to (Live Circuit, On Tour, Annotated Spread…). I can build from that directly instead of rolling again.

options.label: Season Documentary
options.lineage: sports documentary series: title cards over full-bleed footage
options.thesis: The home page opens like a sports documentary: 'A season with' over the wordmark across a full-bleed shot of the students, then chapters.
materials: series title card with the wordmark
options.viewport: The Nationals celebration fills the screen, darkened. 'A SEASON WITH' sits over the wordmark set huge in yellow, with one line and 'Partner with us' below it; a chapter marker in the corner (CH. 01 · Nationals · Mar 2026).
options.risk: Familiar from streaming documentaries; it rests on the quality of the photos and clips.

options.label: Pit Wall
options.lineage: the team's pit at FTC events: a banner, a photo wall, buttons to trade
options.thesis: The page is BrickBot's pit at a competition: a yellow wordmark banner across the top, a wall of pinned student photos, and an open invitation to come and talk.
materials: yellow vinyl banner with the wordmark
white-bordered photos pinned at slight angles
options.viewport: The wordmark banner across the top in yellow; below it, five pinned photos (celebration, drive team, classroom, build, SparkHope win); 'Come find us in the pits' and 'Partner with us' at bottom left.
options.risk: Pinned photos and buttons can tip into the scrapbook or school-project look; it needs strict alignment underneath.

options.label: Engineering Portfolio
options.lineage: FTC engineering portfolios: figures, call-outs, numbered annotations
options.thesis: Laid out like the team's own award-winning engineering portfolio: student photos as numbered figures with yellow call-outs, people and process documented with care.
materials: yellow call-out circles and leader lines
options.viewport: The wordmark at top left, then 'Engineered by students. Documented like professionals.' On the right, a student wiring the robot as Fig. 3 with yellow call-outs, and three smaller plates below.
options.risk: Technical documentation can feel cold; the call-outs must point at people as often as at parts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site with the wordmark and a yellow accent, built to the level of team254.com, citruscircuits.org and a top football club site.
canonCard.viewport: The team photo with the wordmark, a headline and two buttons, then the season, posts and sponsors.
canonCard.risk: Close to the removed first attempt; it looks like every other strong team's site.
